eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Millard, UT; at 4:28 PM on JUL 31, 2026 Effective until 4:28 PM AUG 1, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Millard/Sheriff: Kanosh Mandatory evacuation for Turkey Track Lane & Cemetery Rd. Life-threatening, fast-changing conditions. Leave now and avoid the area. Leave immediately by the designated route. Take only what you have already prepared by the door. Do not stop to gather additional belongings. Help neighbors leave if it is safe to do so. Keep listening to local news and cell phone alerts. Shelter: Fillmore Stake Center. If you cannot leave, call 911.
